mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate signals weakening consumer demand and corporate earnings pressure, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising unemployment are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals weakening aggregate demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining consumption are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 25 basis point or greater increase in the federal funds rate over a 3-month window signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point or greater increase in the unemployment rate over a 3-month window signals accelerating labor market weakness, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of accelerating unemployment are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% or greater decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over a 3-month window signals a sharp demand contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of sharp demand contraction are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 0.3 percentage point or greater increase in the unemployment rate and a 0.5% or greater decline in average weekly hours worked (HOUST) over a 3-month window signals accelerating labor market stress, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3% AND HOUST falls > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of simultaneous unemployment and hours declines are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3% or greater decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over a 3-month window signals a sharp demand contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of sharp demand contraction are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
